definitions: A U-shaped or S-shaped pipe fitting located directly below a sink drain, designed to hold a small amount of water to prevent sewer gases from entering the building.
A plumbing device that creates a water seal to block foul odors and gases from the drainage system while allowing wastewater to pass through.
examples: The plumber replaced the leaky sink trap.
Clean the sink trap regularly to prevent clogs.
A P-trap is a common type of sink trap.
